title: npm test, test:all and test:coverage all run every Vitest project at the base, so the default test command and the coverage command start the fork project and its Hardhat node; the coverage exclude names a folder that does not exist and coverage never runs in CI

evidence.note: test:all is the same command; test:coverage adds --coverage, again all projects
the fork project (globalSetup test/fork/setup.ts, which compiles and starts Hardhat) is part of the default project list
coverage over src/**/*.ts excluding src/dashboard/** (the dashboard lives in dashboard/, not src/), 70% thresholds
CI runs test:unit and test:integration only; no coverage threshold is ever enforced

sibling_sites_checked: Every script in package.json (:8-17) and every project in vitest.config.ts. The fork-harness side (non-hermetic env, ALCHEMY_URL fallback) is AUD-TESTI-017; the dotenv config() in vitest.config.ts:2-4 is AUD-RAIL-002. Plan 22-05 re-scoped npm test and test:coverage to unit and integration (22-29 re-audits the package.json diff).
severity_rationale: S3: a developer typing npm test at the base started Hardhat with the real .env (AUD-TESTI-017 mechanism) and a fork of mainnet; no signing, but the ordinary command reaches the network and real keys. Mitigated by 22-05.
recommendation: Mitigated by plan 22-05 (npm test and test:coverage limited to unit + integration; test:all is the only all-project command); 22-29 re-audits it. Phase 28 sets real coverage floors (OD-23) and fixes the exclude path; Phase 31 makes coverage a CI gate.
